name: nu_std_scripts
test_cmd: cd /testbed && cargo build --profile ci --bin nu && for f in crates/nu-std/tests/test_*.nu; do echo "=== TEST FILE: $f ==="; /testbed/target/ci/nu "$f" 2>&1 || echo "FAILED: $f"; done | tee /output/{output_file}
description: Nushell standard library script tests (.nu files) - requires rebuild to detect START/END differences
